operations.content: Soham is a partial/vibe coder: explain everything in simple words, plain terminal text, no markdown. When he asks for structured/table output, use ASCII +-|= box tables only, width-checked by script before sending; broken tables are a repeated complaint.

Standing rules from Soham: every setup must be finished fully with a live test (never half-done); verify claims with real tool output, not assumptions; every agent gets its own keys/tokens (never copy secrets between Hermes and Neocoder); always search the web when unsure.
Naming: TrailCode (trailhq/Trail-Code, formerly Graft) server here is called trailcode (own map) and trailcode-neocoder (Neocoder project maps); never call it graft to avoid confusion.
